description:
Because:
- FxA has two geodb implementations, and auth and content still use the old fxa-geodb package.

This commit:
- Deletes packages/fxa-geodb and types/fxa-geodb.
- Adds createGeoDBLookup to @fxa/shared/geodb and uses it in auth and content.
- Points the dbPath defaults at libs/shared/geodb/db/cities-db.mmdb.
- Copies the MMDB into the auth dist so the default resolves when compiled.
